pattern.crimePattern: sacked employee returns to rob the clerk who reported him
pattern.notes: Fictional bus company and routes; composite of bus-station booking-office robberies.

ob.reportedBy: A passenger (name withheld), Machakos Country Bus station
ob.text: A passenger reports that the booking clerk of Tana Express, Ruth Nyokabi (35), was found behind the counter of the company's booking office at Machakos Country Bus station at 05:50. Pronounced dead at the scene. The office cash box is missing.

people.name: Ruth Nyokabi
people.bio: Seven years at the Tana Express counter. Reported a tout for selling fake tickets in February.

image.brief: Kenyan woman, mid 30s, hair in neat cornrows, maroon Tana Express staff blouse with a name badge, a pen behind her ear, brisk friendly expression, ID-photo framing

people.name: Stephen Musyoka
people.occupation: Tout for a rival bus company; sacked by Tana Express in February
people.bio: Worked the Tana Express queue for years until Ruth reported him for selling fake tickets. Now touts for Kitui Star Coaches, two bays down.

image.brief: Kenyan man, mid 40s, heavy-set, grey fleece jacket over a Kitui Star Coaches T-shirt, a stack of paper tickets in one hand, narrowed eyes, ID-photo framing

people.name: Kevin Omondi
people.bio: Ruth complained to the depot manager about his late departures twice this month.

image.brief: Kenyan man, late 20s, Tana Express driver's shirt with epaulettes, oil on his hands, cap pushed back, annoyed and anxious, ID-photo framing

people.name: Lilian Jeptoo
people.bio: Handed the counter over to Ruth at 05:00. The two of them had a cold relationship over shift rotas.

image.brief: Kenyan woman, early 30s, maroon Tana Express staff blouse under a cardigan, hair pulled back, tired night-shift eyes, ID-photo framing

people.name: Mwikali Nzioka
people.occupation: Tea vendor at the booking-office door
people.bio: Sells chai and mandazi from a flask and a basin at the office door from 04:30 every day.

image.brief: Kenyan woman, early 50s, a printed kanga tied as a headscarf, a thick brown cardigan against the early cold, warm but cautious face, ID-photo framing

people.name: Gideon Kirui
people.bio: Does every pre-trip check in the yard.

image.brief: Kenyan man, about 40, navy mechanic's overalls with grease on the cuffs, a red rag over one shoulder, short beard, steady wary look, ID-photo framing

places.name: Mwikali's tea stand at the booking-office door
Under the 06:00 Garissa bus, Tana Express yard
Matatu to Kayole, then Lilian's home

locations.name: Tana Express booking office
locations.description: Machakos Country Bus station before dawn. Buses warm up with their engines roaring; the air smells of diesel and mandazi. The booking office is a narrow room with a counter, a carbon ticket book, a ticket punch and a steel cash box bolted to nothing.

hotspots.label: Behind the counter
hotspots.text: Ruth lies behind the counter. The steel ticket punch is on the floor beside her. Her right hand is closed around a torn slip of paper.

hotspots.label: The paper in Ruth's hand
hotspots.text: A torn counterfoil from the ticket book, still damp with her grip.

hotspots.label: Carbon ticket book
hotspots.text: Every ticket is written in duplicate: one for the passenger, one carbon stays in the book with the time.

hotspots.label: Empty space under the counter
hotspots.text: A clean rectangle in the dust where the cash box sat. The night's takings were about KSh 46,000.

image.brief: a cramped bus-company booking office at Machakos Country Bus station before dawn, a wooden counter with a carbon ticket book and a steel ticket punch, buses with headlights on outside the window, diesel haze, no people in frame

locations.name: Bus yard
locations.description: Rows of buses nose to nose. The 05:45 Kitui bus has already left. The 06:00 Garissa bus has its engine cover up. Kitui Star Coaches' buses are parked two bays down.

hotspots.label: Kitui bus conductor (by phone)
hotspots.text: The Kitui bus conductor reads his manifest to Amani over the phone from Thika Road.

hotspots.label: Kitui Star Coaches luggage bay
hotspots.text: The luggage bay of a Kitui Star bus is half open. Behind a sack of maize: a steel box.

hotspots.label: Station gate askari's book
hotspots.text: The gate askari logs every staff member in and out.

hotspots.label: The 06:00 Garissa bus
hotspots.text: Gideon Kirui, the mechanic, wipes his hands and climbs out from under the bus.

image.brief: a crowded bus yard at dawn at Machakos Country Bus, long-distance buses nose to nose with painted liveries, one bus with its rear engine cover open, a luggage bay hatch half open, no people in focus

the bus booking-office counter seen from the public side just after dawn, a heavy steel ticket punch lying on the floor tiles below the counter, ticket stubs scattered across the floor, a stool knocked over, police tape across the doorway, no body visible
a torn pink carbon bus-ticket counterfoil reading 'Kitui 05:45 Seat 14', crumpled, on a wooden counter

body.margin: Note in Ruth's hand, last week: 'Garissa late AGAIN — K.O. — told manager.'

body.label: Steel cash box stencilled TANA EXPRESS. Lock forced. Empty.

image.brief: a dented grey steel cash box stencilled 'TANA EXPRESS', lid forced open and empty, lying behind a sack of maize in a bus luggage bay

facts.text: Ruth Nyokabi was found behind the Tana Express counter at 05:50.
The booking office's cash box, about KSh 46,000, is missing.
Ruth was struck once with the office's own steel ticket punch.
The counterfoil in Ruth's hand: Kitui 05:45, seat 14, issued 05:22.
The carbon book's last ticket is seat 14 on the Kitui bus at 05:22. The one before was 05:09.
Night clerk Lilian Jeptoo handed the counter to Ruth at 05:00.
Ruth's margin note: the Garissa driver, K.O., was late again; she told the manager.
Kitui manifest: seat 14, S. Musyoka, booked to Kitui.
Seat 14 was marked 'no show'. The Kitui bus left at 05:51 with the seat empty.
The forced, empty Tana Express cash box was in the luggage bay of a Kitui Star Coaches bus.
Mwikali saw Stephen Musyoka buy a ticket at the counter at about 05:20.
Mwikali: "He never travels, that one. He lives here."
Stephen now touts for Kitui Star Coaches, two bays down.
Ruth reported Stephen in February for selling fake Tana Express tickets. He was sacked.
Mwikali: the Garissa driver, Kevin Omondi, has been under his bus with the mechanic since five.
Gideon: Kevin did the pre-trip check with him under the Garissa bus from 05:00 to 05:50.
Gideon: Mwikali brought them tea under the bus at 05:30, and she'd been at her stand all morning.
Gideon was under the Garissa bus with Kevin from 05:00 to 05:50.
Gate log: L. Jeptoo left the station at 05:04.
Lilian's matatu receipt: Country Bus to Kayole at 05:10. Her landlady saw her arrive home at 05:45.
Stephen: "I bought a ticket and changed my mind. Is that a crime?"
Stephen: "I never touched her. I never touched that box."
Kevin: "I was under my bus. Ask Gideon."
Lilian: "I handed over at five and went home. We didn't like each other. That's all."

interrogations.intro: Mwikali pours Amani a cup of chai without asking. "Drink. You'll need it. That girl was good to me."

topics.reply: Musyoka bought a ticket at twenty past five. Him! He hasn't travelled anywhere in ten years. Since February he touts for Kitui Star, two bays down.
Kevin has been under the Garissa bus with Gideon since five. I took them tea.
Lilian left at five past five like every Friday. She takes the Kayole matatu.

interrogations.intro: Gideon climbs out from under the Garissa bus. "Ruth? No. No."

topics.reply: He held the torch for me the whole check. Five to ten to six. Brake lines, belts, tyres. He didn't move.

interrogations.intro: Stephen leans on a Kitui Star bus, calling passengers. He stops when he sees Amani's badge.

topics.reply: That woman lost me my job for two tickets. Two! Every manamba sells a few. But I didn't touch her.
Anyone can open a luggage bay. Ask who drives that bus.

interrogations.intro: Kevin drops his spanner. "She reported me twice this month. Now people will say I did it."

topics.reply: She was strict about time. She was right, mostly. I'm late because the bus is old.

interrogations.intro: Lilian, by phone from Kayole, half asleep: "Ruth? But I left her at five. She was fine."

topics.reply: We fought about rotas. Not about anything real. I'm sorry I said bad things about her.

chargeSheet.template: {who} killed {victim} at the Tana Express booking office.

prosecutor.pass: The last ticket she ever wrote was his, and he never got on the bus. That will hold.
fail: This doesn't hold up. Who was standing at that counter at 05:22?
No. Match the paper in her hand to the bus it belongs to.

proof.concludes: The last person Ruth served, at 05:22, bought seat 14 on the 05:45 Kitui bus.
Seat 14 was Stephen Musyoka, who was seen buying it at 05:20 and never boarded.

eliminations.why: Kevin was under the Garissa bus with the mechanic from 05:00 to 05:50.
Lilian left the station at 05:04, eighteen minutes before the 05:22 sale, and was on a matatu home.
Mwikali was at her tea stand serving the queue all morning.
Gideon was under the Garissa bus with Kevin the whole time.

reconstruction.text: February: Ruth reports a tout for selling fake Tana Express tickets. Stephen Musyoka loses his job.
05:20, Friday. Stephen comes to the counter and buys seat 14 on the 05:45 to Kitui, so he has a reason to be standing there.
05:22. While Ruth writes the counterfoil, he reaches for the cash box. She grabs his sleeve. He hits her with the ticket punch and takes the box.
He forces the box, empties it, and hides it in the luggage bay of the Kitui Star bus where he now works. Seat 14 leaves Machakos Country Bus empty.
Ruth kept hold of the counterfoil. It was the last thing she wrote.

tier1.line: She was holding something. Every ticket has two halves. Find the other half.

tier2.line: Seat fourteen at 05:22, and seat fourteen empty when the bus left. Who books a seat he doesn't take?

glossary.def: Tout who calls passengers onto buses or matatus.
Tea, usually boiled with milk and sugar.
Fried dough snack, like a light doughnut.

ui.beatNotes: First map: two locations (booking office, bus yard). Moving between them. First paper match: tapping the counterfoil and the manifest shows them side by side in the notebook.
